text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Trade minister to head Kuwait's delegation to the World Trade Organisation meeting in Singapore.
- Crown Prince says aggressive intentions of the Iraqi regime threaten our sovereignty.
- Parliament to discuss privatisation law proposal during its current term.
- Refining capacity of the Kuwait National Petroleum Company rises to 850,000 barrels per day.
- Kuwait and China enjoy strong trade and investment ties, Kuwaiti official says.
- United Arab Emirates rejected an Iraqi request to normalise relations, Gulf diplomatic source says.
- Kuwait's foreign minister says no dispute with United Arab Emirates over UAE's call to reconsider ties with Iraq.
